_comment: Default IFCT entries for ambiguous common food terms. Used by IngredientMatcher when multiple entries match.

rice.note: Most common white rice in Indian cooking. 7 rice entries in IFCT.

wheat.note: Default Indian wheat usage — atta for roti/chapati. 7 wheat entries in IFCT.

dal.note: Toor dal — most common across India. 5 true dals in IFCT. Log ambiguous at match time.

chicken.note: Most common diet-plan cut. N001 (leg) has suspect macros.

egg.note: Standard poultry egg. Form context determines raw vs boiled.

fish.note: 100+ fish entries, no single default. Log ambiguous and require specific fish name.

oil.note: Neutral cooking oil. Cuisine-specific overrides below.

milk.note: More common in dietary contexts than buffalo milk.

curd.note: Manual seed entry. Also matches yogurt, dahi.

butter.note: No butter entry in IFCT. Falls back to Edamam/USDA.
